provenance.description: Owned editable SmartArt, regenerated and saved by the native reference application, exported locally to PDF. Expected geometry comes only from native drawing XML; browser traces supply glyph predicates, never geometry. Four crossing controls also disprove treating equal envelope samples as proof of a constant envelope. All native PDF pages visually reviewed. Additional automatic aspect reservations cover equivalent upper/lower bounds, different dimensions and offsets, and root/nested scopes. Live dimension-reference controls also vary negative offsets, forward references, projection/clipping order and independent center/trailing/parent/literal reference lifetimes.
